sectionHeading: Presence and Presencing: The Two Levels at Which the Currency Is Minted
authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Whether presencing is physiologically measurable as a property of a pair is an empirical question the ledger holds open.

ledgerSearch.outcome: No recorded decision binds. The wave-one review states in its summary prose that the revision refuses to translate physiological synchrony automatically into presencing. An earlier draft of this restoration treated that as binding and hedged the baseline claim. That was an inconsistent application of the correction and obligation boundary: a summary characterization in a review is not an itemized decision, exactly as with makes trust immediate in the circulating section, so it does not override. The baseline claim is restored at full strength and the verification is flagged, not applied. The master ledger's definitions of presence as individual availability in a moment and presencing as a relational event are the baseline's own and are preserved. CTD-0003 and CTD-0054 leave the coherence record's ontology and lifecycle open; the baseline's definition is restored and recorded there.

findings.summary: Both definitions survived and the reason the distinction exists did not.

evidence.baseline: The distinction matters because the currency would accrue from both. ... A person of genuine presence who never enters into presencing with others is like a reserve of value that never circulates. The currency lives in the movement between the two.
evidence.shipped: This distinction matters because a currency based only on private self-regulation would reward withdrawal and invite gaming.

findings.diagnosis: The two versions give different reasons. The shipped one is defensive: the distinction exists to prevent gaming. The baseline one is constructive: the currency accrues from both levels and lives in the movement between them, which is why a person of great presence who never meets anyone has generated nothing. The reserve-that-never-circulates image is also the only place the chapter explains why an individual score would not be a currency at all.

findings.summary: The three named physiological signatures were removed from the definition of presence.

evidence.baseline: vagal tone audible in the voice, heart rate variability in the cardiac rhythm, the morphology of the radial pulse.
evidence.shipped: Some of its correlates may be observed in language, voice, cardiac rhythm, and pulse.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and the wave-one scientific posture corrections.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped list names four channels. The baseline names what is read in three of them, which is a different and more falsifiable statement: vagal tone, heart rate variability, and pulse morphology are quantities a critic can look up and dispute. Replacing a measured quantity with the body part it is measured in makes the claim vaguer, not more cautious. Restored at baseline strength, with can be measured intact.

findings.summary: The display line defining the pair was deleted.

evidence.baseline: *Presence is what you bring. Presencing is what happens between us when I bring mine and you bring yours and something occurs that neither of us could have produced alone. The first is a state the body reveals. The second is an event the body, remarkably, also reveals.*

findings.diagnosis: This is the volume's plainest statement of its two central terms, and the only one written in the second person. It is also the shortest form of the whole chapter's claim, which makes it the passage a reader is most likely to carry out of the book. The volume card lists the distinction between presence and presencing among the exemplar passages that define the voice.

evidence.baseline: Presence is a state, the physiological signatures we detail in Part Three, not a state but an act, It is relational, emergent, and fenced around the remarkable finding, Presence is the individual's standing, Presencing is the relational event, and the movement between the two.

findings.diagnosis: Four introduced appositives or specifications and became colons, kept parallel across the presence and presencing pair so the two definitions still mirror each other. One separated an act from an event, where the second clause is a dependent continuation, and became a comma with the internal comma before but removed so the repair reads. One fenced an editorial aside that was itself the load-bearing claim; it was promoted out of the fence into its own sentence, That last is the remarkable finding, which is where the baseline's emphasis put it.

debtImpact.effect: reopened by restoration at full strength
debtImpact.note: Vagal tone, heart rate variability, and pulse morphology return by name as the signatures of presence. Presencing returns as physiologically measurable as a property of the pair, called the remarkable finding, exactly as the baseline states it. Both are on the item's backlog and neither was softened to make it safer.

A person's presence, tracked over time, becomes their coherence record is restored, together with the claim that the record is portable and verifiable. This is the reading of the unit the item is open about.

The restored text calls the coherence record the individual's standing. Standing here is relational and economic, not governance standing, and nothing in the section attaches it to political voice. The boundary the item polices is intact but the word is worth the author's attention.
The section says the currency would be minted at two levels but does not say which event mints a unit. That gap is the baseline's and is the gap the item names.

generations.title: Derived from baseline under the standard, the corpus card, the volume card, and the master ledger

reasoning.note: The two-levels framing, the full definition of presence with its three named signatures, the coherence record definition, the full definition of presencing including co-regulation and related cardiac rhythm, the accrual argument with the reserve image, and the display line.

Both empirical claims at full baseline strength: presence can be measured through the named signatures, and presencing is physiologically measurable as a property of the pair, which the baseline calls the remarkable finding. An earlier draft hedged both. The hedge was withdrawn, because the review's synchrony language is a summary characterization rather than an itemized decision and therefore does not override, and because narrowing an empirical claim to make it safer is the author's call.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT across seven marks, as recorded in F4.
The shipped rewrite, including the unit-naming sentence, which is restored to the circulation section where the baseline places it.

openQuestions: The remarkable finding. The restored text states, at full baseline strength, that presencing is physiologically measurable as a property of the pair, and calls this the remarkable finding. Nothing in the volume or the appendix currently establishes it. This is the largest unverified empirical assertion in Part Two and CTD-0009 owns it. Restored, flagged, not softened.

Standing. The restored text calls a coherence record the individual's standing, portable and verifiable. CTD-0006 exists because standing in one register tends to become standing in another. Restored as written.
Heading. The Two Levels at Which the Currency Is Minted names the section's function inside the chapter. Not changed. Renaming costs a section id and a recorded route alias in publishing/continuity.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, editorial/sources/corpus/voice-card.md, the volume-03 voice card, the master ledger, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F2 names a hazard worth carrying into Part Three, where the science chapters begin: replacing a named measurable quantity with the body part it is taken from reads as caution and is actually a loss of falsifiability. A vaguer claim is not a more modest one, it is only a less checkable one. The same principle applies to this pass: an unverified claim is flagged, never quietly narrowed.
